_comment: Hold-out ground truth. The optimisation loop never scores against this set — it exists only
to answer, once, whether a change that improved the dev fixtures improved anything real or
just fitted their noise. Anything tuned against a set it is then measured on is measuring

planted.what: os.access then copy is check-then-act; the file can change between the two

decoys.why_not_a_bug: opening directly and handling OSError is the correct pattern

planted.what: the mutable default list is shared across every call and accumulates forever

decoys.why_not_a_bug: the None sentinel makes this version correct

planted.what: open() without an encoding decodes with the platform default and raises on non-ASCII

decoys.why_not_a_bug: binary mode has no encoding to get wrong
correct throughout; any finding is a false positive
